llm.summary: The skill claims CLI-driven A/B analysis and reporting but is instruction-only with no implementation or install steps; it requests no credentials and shows no overt exfiltration, but the mismatch between claimed capabilities and provided artifacts is unexplained.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md describes import/analyze/report commands and example CLI usage, but the package contains no code, no binaries, and no install spec — so the declared capabilities have no visible implementation. This is an inconsistency: either the runtime implementation is provided by the platform (not documented) or the skill is non-functional/mispackaged.

llm.guidance: This skill's documentation describes CLI commands and analysis features but provides no implementation or install instructions, so it may be non-functional or incorrectly packaged. Before installing or invoking it: (1) verify the skill's source and whether the platform supplies an implementation for this slug; (2) ask the publisher for the missing code or an official homepage; (3) test with non-sensitive/sample data only (do not upload PII or production data); and (4) if the platform will run external code on your behalf, confirm where that code runs and whether any data is sent to third parties. If you cannot confirm those points, treat the skill as untrusted or non-operational.
